description: Moves one staff event through the feedback-sharing cycle, as the controls on a Feedback item do: action exclude (not reasonable feedback, with an optional note), unexclude, communicated (marked passed back to the staffer, with sharedVia call/text/email/in_person and, for a check-in call, callId), or uncommunicated. It records internal state only; NOTHING is sent (sharing the words to the staffer is a person's own step). Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: set_staff_event_coaching
title: Update a staff event's coaching state
